question: Let $n\ge3$. There are $n$ straight lines in a plane, no two of which are parallel and no three pass through a common point. Their points of intersection are joined. Then the number of fresh line segments thus created is
solution:
The $n$ lines have $\binom n2$ intersection points. On each original line there are $n-1$ intersection points, giving $\binom{n-1}{2}$ segments per line. Hence the number of fresh segments is
\[
\binom{\binom n2}{2}-n\binom{n-1}{2}=\frac{n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3)}8.
\]
